item_short_desc: Enhance your outdoor experience with Rothco’s Self-Inflating Air Mat, a must-have for camping, hiking, or any adventure. This mat features sponge foam cushioning for superior comfort and insulation, ensuring a good night's sleep in the great outdoors. The self-inflating design eliminates the need for a pump, making setup quick and easy. When not in use, the mat rolls up compactly and secures with 2 included tie-down straps for effortless transport and storage.
description: Enhance your outdoor experience with Rothco’s Self-Inflating Air Mat, a must-have for camping, hiking, or any adventure. This mat features sponge foam cushioning for superior comfort and insulation, ensuring a good night's sleep in the great outdoors. The self-inflating design eliminates the need for a pump, making setup quick and easy. When not in use, the mat rolls up compactly and secures with 2 included tie-down straps for effortless transport and storage. Measuring 6 feet when fully expanded, it provides ample sleeping space for most users. A convenient carrying case is included, adding to its portability and protection. Durable and lightweight, this air mat is perfect for anyone seeking comfort and convenience during their outdoor escapes.
